cookie.citation: Stewart ML, Zimmer JP. A high fiber cookie made with resistant starch type 4 reduces post-prandial glucose and insulin responses in healthy adults. Nutrients 2017;9:237. PMC5372900
cookie.design: double-blind randomized controlled crossover; 51 screened, 28 enrolled; 3 randomized to control-fiber sequence did not complete second treatment; up to 2 per arm unanalysable samples; 12 h fast; cookie with 250 mL water; 7-day washout
cookie.ingredient: VERSAFIBE 1490: potato distarch phosphate RS4, 90% TDF (AOAC 991.43); fibre cookie contained 25 g ingredient; control cookie amount 0
cookie.composition_method: calculated with Genesis R&D Food Labeling Software (ESHA); kcal method not stated; arms 'matched for fat, protein, and total carbohydrate'

insulin_iAUC_0_120.unit_printed: pmol/L*h ('*' is a footnote marker; the Cmax row is also printed 'pmol/L*h', and glucose Cmax 'mmol/L*h', so the time unit in this table is not reliable)
insulin_iAUC_0_120.operator: trapezoidal approximation including only positive area components above baseline (explicit; cites Wolever 2004); fasting sample as baseline; post-meal samples 15,30,45,60,90,120 min after consumption
insulin_iAUC_0_120.matrix_assay: intravenous serum; Life Labs (Hamilton, ON, Canada); assay platform not stated
insulin_iAUC_0_120.analysis: iAUC square-root transformed before analysis; p<0.001; abstract states 46% reduction

scone.citation: Stewart ML, Wilcox ML, Bell M, Buggia MA, Maki KC. Type-4 resistant starch in substitution for available carbohydrate reduces postprandial glycemic response and hunger in acute, randomized, double-blind, controlled study. Nutrients 2018;10:129. doi 10.3390/nu10020129. PMC5852705
scone.design: double-blind randomized controlled crossover; 43 screened, 36 randomized, 1 terminated for compliance; 35 in satiety/GI/palatability; 32 in glucose/insulin analyses because of missing samples from at least one visit; missing data not imputed; scone with 240 mL water within 10 min, further 178 mL offered
scone.ingredient: VERSAFIBE 2470: high-amylose maize RS4 (acid hydrolysis + heat treatment), 70% dietary fibre (AOAC 2009.01); provided 16.5 g dietary fibre in the fibre scone; replaced refined wheat flour
scone.composition_method: analysed by Medallion Labs (fat AOAC 996.06, protein AOAC 992.15, sugar AOAC 977.20, fibre AOAC 2009.01); total CHO by difference; energy by Atwater factors 9 fat, 4 protein, 4 available CHO (printed '4 kcal/d protein')

insulin_iAUC_0_120.locator: Table 3 (n = 32), 'Venous insulin iAUC 0-120 min (min x pmol/L)'
insulin_iAUC_0_120.operator: t = -15 min pre-consumption sample counted as t = 0; samples 15,30,45,60,90,120,180 min from start of consumption; 'Areas under the curve were calculated using the trapezoidal rule [24]' (ref 24 = Brouns ... Wolever, Glycaemic index methodology, 2005); positive-only / below-baseline handling NOT stated
insulin_iAUC_0_120.matrix_assay: venous plasma; Cleveland Heart Lab; electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (Roche Cobas e411)
insulin_iAUC_0_120.analysis: repeated-measures ANOVA with subject random; p = 0.0005; iAUC values not ranked (Cmax ranked)

gourineni_anchor_notes.matrix_assay: venous plasma; Cleveland Heart Lab; electrochemiluminescence immunoassay (platform not named)
gourineni_anchor_notes.operator: t = -5 min (-15 to -2 acceptable) as 0; 15,30,45,60,90,120 min; area above pre-consumption value without below-baseline subtraction
gourineni_anchor_notes.stat: mean +/- SEM; per-arm iAUC n not printed; Figure 2 n = 37/36/37 (unequal); 38 evaluable

du.reason: no numeric arm insulin data admitted; only an abstract statement of no significant difference. No verdict is computed.
